scope: New-intent checkpoint projection only; ordinary checkpoints, durability and ownership remain synchronous/unchanged.

red.classification: Unused old JSON materialization in fresh-intent writes on original source

full_postgres.qualification: Includes the 22 new cases; focused results overlap this count.

final_paired.qualification: Real local PostgreSQL; alternating seven pairs, full/default reader counterfactual versus final projection. Timings are evidence, not thresholds. Scoped DB recorder work, no real exchange/network or MM p99 measurement.

statements:
SELECT market_states.id AS market_states_id, market_states.config_file_path AS market_states_config_file_path, market_states.market AS market_states_market, market_states.timestamp AS market_states_timestamp, market_states.saved_state AS market_states_saved_state 
FROM market_states 
WHERE market_states.config_file_path = %(config_file_path_1)s AND market_states.market = %(market_1)s

SELECT orders.id AS orders_id, orders.creation_pending AS orders_creation_pending 
FROM orders 
WHERE orders.config_file_path = %(config_file_path_1)s AND orders.market = %(market_1)s AND (orders.id IN (%(id_1_1)s) OR orders.creation_pending IS true)

SELECT b.bot_id, b.config_file_path, b.config_type, b.desired_state, b.control_version,
                    b.acknowledged_version, b.owner_uuid, b.owner_generation, b.heartbeat, b.revision,
                    b.recovery_state, b.mm_session, pg_backend_pid() AS backend_pid,
                    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp()) AS database_now FROM public.bot_state b
                WHERE bot_id=%(bot_id)s AND owner_uuid=%(owner)s AND owner_generation=%(generation)s
                AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_locks WHERE locktype='advisory' AND granted
                    AND pid=pg_backend_pid() AND classid=%(namespace)s AND objid=%(key)s AND objsubid=2)

SELECT bot_state.owner_generation 
FROM bot_state 
WHERE bot_state.bot_id = %(bot_id_1)s AND bot_state.owner_uuid = %(owner_uuid_1)s AND bot_state.owner_generation = %(owner_generation_1)s FOR SHARE
UPDATE market_states SET timestamp=%(timestamp)s WHERE market_states.id = %(market_states_id)s

rejected_experiments.reason: Suppresses unchanged JSON writes but large unchanged checkpoints still cost more. Removed; no new equality/hash/cache remains.

rejected_experiments.name: overstrict_test_expectation
rejected_experiments.reason: Expected one lazy load across two checkpoint calls; that assumes reuse across ORM flushes. Bound is one read per checkpoint, not an authority/data cache across calls.

rejected_experiments.name: superseded_broad_runs
rejected_experiments.qualification: Not accepted final-source gates. Source scope changed during exploration; PG run deliberately interrupted after 74 passes. Final frozen-source gates are above.

guarantees: Same owner/control/row fences and durable commit before transport; no asynchronous recorder worker.
Fresh intent skips old JSON only while its identity is present in current tracking.
Missing pending identities cause a single lazy old-JSON read per checkpoint; full cold restore remains the default.
Ordinary/unchanged checkpoints and untracked-intent fallback retain the full-reader path.
Read/commit failures roll back the new intent and preserve prior tracking; owner loss cannot commit it.
limitations: Large synthetic fixture is not an observed size/root cause for the six prior probe events.
No claim all small paths are faster, no end-to-end MM latency/uptime or RSS improvement claim.
Missing pending tracking adds one conditional read; query/payload tradeoffs are retained.
Native/PG gates do not qualify a new container or replace previous image/load evidence.
Original synchronous fill/ownership I/O can still delay the engine loop; probe timeout/grace unchanged.

earlier_scoped_paired_measurements.qualification: Retain all earlier scoped pairs, including slower small-fixture timings. Final measurement is a separately labelled standalone repeat after broad regressions.
